purpose: Prevent the shared term Nexus from collapsing historically distinct JANUS organs into one asserted code lineage.

NEXUS_RUNTIME_MODULE_ORCHESTRATOR.role: select/load/run/quarantine or health-track executable modules and services
NEXUS_RUNTIME_MODULE_ORCHESTRATOR.rex_relation: Rex-generated candidates can enter the live-module path, but generation does not grant admission authority

NEXUS_P0_PRESERVATION_INTEGRATION.role: source pinning, variant lineage, materialization, exact-source manifest/freezer, recovery and merge-admission evidence
NEXUS_P0_PRESERVATION_INTEGRATION.functional_relation: STRONG: both mediate what may become part of a larger JANUS organism, but at different evidence layers

routing_rules: Runtime execution authority must not be inferred from registry contact edges.
P0 provenance admission must not be inferred from successful runtime execution alone.
A generated module is a candidate organ until independent gates admit it.
canonical_rule: NEXUS IS A FAMILY OF GATES; SHARED NAME ALONE DOES NOT PROVE SHARED BYTES OR AUTHORITY.
